name: Panacea Biotec Limited
summary: Panacea Biotec Limited, a biotechnology company, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and marketing of vaccines, pharmaceutical formulations, nutraceuticals, and food and nutrition products in India and internationally. The company operates through Vaccines and Pharmaceutical Formulations & Nutrition segments.
